models.role: Default reasoning, vision, video and coding model

pricingUsdPerMillion.note: Muse Spark 1.2 standard pricing; 1.3 reported unchanged. Verify on the pricing page.
Listed for 1.2 contributor. Meta may train on prompts and completions. Rate limited in a rolling window.

models.useFor: Internal test builds only, never user data

models.role: Complex, long-horizon agentic work; audio input; web search

pricingUsdPerMillion.note: From a third-party pricing write-up during preview. Verify.

models.rateLimits: 3,000 requests and 4M tokens per minute (third-party report, verify)

output: image (b64_json default, or temporary signed url)

parameters.size: WxH string that sets aspect ratio, up to 16:1

pricing.note: Failed or safety-filtered images are not billed

errors.400: bad prompt, size or unknown field; content_policy_violation for safety blocks

models.role: Find, outline and track objects in images and video from a short text prompt, boxes or points
models.promptRules: One short noun phrase per call. No lists, commands, questions or negation. Box and point tokens need the media's displayed width and height.

pricing.note: Video billed per frame, 50-frame minimum per request. Rates on Meta's pricing page.

models.role: Speech to text with turn detection and speaker labels
output: transcript with turn-level timing, no word-level timestamps
models.realtimeAudio: PCM16 mono at 16 kHz or 24 kHz, per LiteLLM's docs

models.name: Muse Glimmer
models.role: Local and edge agent model distilled from Muse Spark
facts: Meta's quantized build is under 20 GB
runs on vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp or ExecuTorch
models.howToUse: Self-host, or call an OpenAI-compatible endpoint you run on Modal, Baseten or Fireworks. Not on the Model API.

models.name: Muse Spark Open
facts: 816B total parameters, 42B active, mixture of experts
text, images, audio and video in, text out

models.name: Muse Code
models.role: Terminal and CI coding agent that writes every Muse Muse product

models.auth: META_API_KEY, then a stored key, then a browser session
